out_items.name: Food separated and protected

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shell egg stored above cut and cleaned jalapeño in 3 door prep unit (right side)
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. Person in charge placed raw egg below all ready to eat food items.

out_items.name: Proper cold holding temperatures

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: bean sprout (50F), cooked sticky rice (49F), vegetable spring roll (51F) in walk in cooler; cooked pork belly (48F), bean sprout (63F) in 3 door prep unit (right side)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Person in charge discarded all items.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed raw shell eggs stored on cook line at (73F)
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. Person in charge discarded eggs.

out_items.name: In-use utensils properly stored

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: in use rice scoop in ambient water (78F)
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. Person in charge removed water from container and cleaned rice scoop properly.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: walk in cooler observed at ambient temperature of 49F at beginning of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. Person in charge adjusted cooler temperature and unit was observed at 41F before end of inspection. All refrigeration must hold an ambient temperature at or below 41F. It is recommended that walk in cooler receives service by a repair technician due to history of increased temperature in unit. Thaisons Restaurant (Inspection Date: 09/15/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers stored in prep areas in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. Person in charge discarded contaminated taro.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: Heat sensitive test strip available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine was observed without batteries.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. Person in charge replaced batteries during inspection.

violations.title: Manual Wash Water Temperature
violations.observation: The temperature of the in-use wash water solution was observed at less than 110F. Three compartment sink observed at 83F.
violations.corrective_action: The temperature of the wash solution for manual warewashing machine must be no less than 110F or the temperature specified on the cleaning agent manufacturer's label instructions. Person in charge contacted technician during inspection. Follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Hot and cold water available, adequate pressure

violations.title: Hot Water Capacity to Meet Peak Demands
violations.observation: The water heater / boiler serving the food service establishment is no longer operable
violations.corrective_action: Hot water generation and distribution systems shall be sufficient to meet the peak hot water demands throughout the food establishment. At this time, a new commercial, approved water heater shall be installed to meet the peak hot water demands. The water heater shall be approved prior to installation. Person in charge contacted technician during inspection. Water heater will be repaired or replaced. Follow-up will be conducted within 10 days.

out_items.name: Approved thawing methods used

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: whole raw duck, sliced tofu at ambient in prep sink.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process. PIC provided cold running water over thawing items in sink.
